subject: Assign different http page address for each tab in tabset or tab in navbar

messages.author: 3dc89d3147ac0901
messages.subject: Assign different http page address for each tab in tabset or tab in navbar
parts:
Hi team,

From the Shiny Sever's Admin Dashboard, I believe we can have different page address for tabs in Navbar. (e.g. '/#/dashboard') I am now using fluid page with tabsetpanel. Can we do this for tabs in tabset panel? If it only works for Navbar, I am willing to change my layout to Navbar. Do you have an example code for this? When I have looked at the Shiny Gallary's Navbar example, unlike the admin dashboard, it doesn't have different page address for each Navbar tabs. It seems useful with google analytics page tracking. 

example code:

runApp(list(
  ui = navbarPage("R", tabPanel("a",
    numericInput('n', 'Number of obs', 100),
    plotOutput('plot')),
    tabPanel("b"),
    tabPanel("c")
    ),
  server = function(input, output) {
    output$plot <- renderPlot({ hist(runif(input$n)) })
  }
))


Thanks in advance!

Sincerely,
Joon

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: Assign different http page address for each tab in tabset or tab in navbar
parts:
Hi Joon,

Unfortunately, this isn't natively supported in Shiny. There are a couple of ways to do it, but they'd involve dropping down into the JavaScript, sadly.

I believe this page would get you pointed in the right direction: http://tylermerrick.com/blog/index.php/2010/12/08/integrating-google-analytics-with-jquery-tabs/ . This one may also be helpful: http://www.websiteoptimizers.com/blog/get-started-with-google-analytics-events-tracking/

Basically, you would need to use custom events in Google Analytics to notify Google every time your user did this action of interest (switch tabs) since Google Analytics typically just works on page views.

Jeff

Jeff,

In the blog, he shared a JS code as follows:

$(document).ready(function () {
if ($("#tabs").length != 0){
$("#tabs").bind("tabsselect",function(event,ui) {
_gaq.push(['_trackPageview', window.location.pathname + '/' + ui.tab.innerHTML]);
});
}
});

Should I just copy and paste the above code, wrap it around with HTML(""), and put it onto each tabPanel()? Can you teach me how to integrate JS code on ui.R?


Thank you in advance.


Sincerely,
Joon
